name: Steal A Forsaken
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal A Forsaken

New Content Update:
- Christmas Event!
- New Characters!

You can earn money offline💸

👍 Like the game and join the group
How to Play:
Buy Characters - Use your money to purchase unique Survivors & Killers and build your collection. 
Steal Characters – Challenge other players and Steal their Characters to grow your empire.
💸 Generate Money – Your Characters earn money over time. The more you have, the faster you grow!
🔥 Rebirth – Reset your progress in exchange for powerful bonuses and faster earnings.

all in-game assets are entirely original 

🔥Credit to Forsaken Team for inspiration
